items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1Njc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--40a4223db9dd06f7297c00e40277715abf8db574/image.png) Ο διαγωνισμός **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** σηματοδοτεί την έναρξη της αγωνιστικής σεζόν 2026–2027 για το ελληνικό speedcubing. Cubers από όλη την Ελλάδα θα συναντηθούν για ένα διήμερο γεμάτο γρήγορες λύσεις, προσωπικά ρεκόρ και δυνατές αναμετρήσεις, ανοίγοντας με τον καλύτερο τρόπο τη νέα σεζόν των επίσημων WCA διαγωνισμών. Ο διαγωνισμός έχει και ξεχωριστή σημασία, καθώς αποτελεί τον πρώτο αγώνα που θα προσμετρήσει στη νεοσύστατη **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), εγκαινιάζοντας μια νέα εποχή για το ελληνικό αγωνιστικό cubing. Είτε συμμετέχεις για την εμπειρία, είτε κυνηγάς νέες επιδόσεις και πολύτιμους βαθμούς στη League, το **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** είναι το ιδανικό ξεκίνημα της σεζόν. **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **B μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **MONO σε έναν από τους δύο σε αυτή τη σειρά**. Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2X2 * 5X5 * One-Handed (OH) Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) The competition **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** marks the beginning of the 2026–2027 competitive season for Greek speedcubing. Cubers from all over Greece will gather for a two-day event filled with fast solves, personal bests, and exciting competition, kicking off the new season of official WCA competitions in the best possible way. This competition is also of special significance, as it will be the first event to count towards the newly established **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), marking the beginning of a new era for competitive cubing in Greece. Whether you are participating for the experience or aiming for new personal bests and valuable League points, New Cubing Season Athens 2026 is the perfect way to start the season. Important: This competition **is Part B** of a two-competition series. Competitors may participate in ONLY one of the two competitions in this series. **Events (Part B):** * 3x3 * 2X2 * 5X5 * One-Handed (OH) Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown II 2026

venue.name: [Swiss Games Museum](https://museedujeu.ch/)
venue.details: On the ground floor, entrance through the court

items.information: Le Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown fait partie de la [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), qui se compose de plusieurs compétitions réparties sur toute l'année. Tout le monde est le bienvenu, que vous souhaitiez ou non participer à la finale de la Swisscubing Cup. Pour cette compétition, **les points de qualification pour la finale de la Swisscubing Cup 2026 ne peuvent être cumulés que dans les disciplines suivantes : 3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, Multi-Blind et FMC.** Toutes les autres disciplines présentes lors de cette compétition ne font pas partie de la Swisscubing Cup. **Note aux débutants :** Cette compétition s'adresse prioritairement aux compétiteurs expérimentés et est organisée en conséquence. Bien que les débutants soient les bienvenus, l'expérience montre que peu d'autres néophytes participent à ce tournoi spécifique. Pour une première expérience en compétition, un tournoi plus "accessible" est souvent un choix plus agréable. __________________________ Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup. **Note for newcomers:** This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2026 Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 175kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å være med. --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Sandnes Open 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 175 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.information: **Español** Esta es la primera competencia organizada en esta sede y también será la primera competencia oficial del año en Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 será una competencia oficial de la World Cube Association (WCA), inspirada en la cultura maya y en la figura de Kukulcán, uno de los símbolos más representativos de Mesoamérica. Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de alta calidad, promoviendo la comunidad del speedcubing en el occidente de Guatemala y mostrando parte de nuestra identidad y cultura a todos los participantes. Esta competencia se llevará a cabo en dos locaciones diferentes. Para consultar la ubicación correspondiente a cada día, revisa la pestaña “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout”, donde se indica la ubicación de la competencia para el viernes 11, así como para los días sábado 12 y domingo 13. ¡Sean todos bienvenidos a Quetzaltenango y esperamos que disfruten de Kukulcán Open 2026! **English** This is the first competition organized at this venue and also the first official WCA competition of the year in Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition inspired by the Mayan culture and Kukulcán, one of the most iconic symbols of Mesoamerica. Our goal is to provide a high-quality competition while helping grow the speedcubing community in western Guatemala and sharing part of our culture and identity with every participant. This competition will take place at two different venues. Please refer to the “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout” tab to find the competition location for Friday the 11th, as well as for Saturday the 12th and Sunday the 13th. Welcome to Quetzaltenango—we hope you enjoy Kukulcán Open 2026! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2Njg3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--be50ae158823f554eaf24566a8f1a7aa4c6d9eb2/IMG_4169.png)

venue.name: Palisades Center
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994
venue.details: 4th Floor, Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room

items.information: This is the New York state championship for big cubes (5x5, 6x6, and 7x7) and quiet events (3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multi-Blind)! This competition is open to everyone, but only New York residents are eligible for New York champion titles - see the Championship Eligibility tab for more info. There are **separate registration limits** for each event. Out of courtesy for other competitors, please only register for events that you actually plan to compete in. If every individual event has already reached its limit, no further registrations will be accepted, even if the overall limit of 60 hasn't been reached. 4BLD, 5BLD, MBLD: 30 competitors each 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3BLD, FMC: 40 competitors each Please avoid bringing unnecessary guests, especially on Days 2 and 3, to help the competition stay quiet. The Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcxNjY5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a8ab6aa393063e4885b78fe22730fbdb06d76ab9/Kewbz%20UKC26%20LOGO.jpg) ## Welcome to the Kewbz UK Championship 2026! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending the Kewbz UK Championship 2026, you'll receive a Kewbz UK Championship 2026 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** This competition is open to first-time competitors, who will only be able to compete in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, and 3x3 One-Handed. If you would like to attempt to qualify for other events, you must do so another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 16th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **there are no qualifications for 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, or 3x3 One-Handed.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals for all events. In 3x3, any non-UK competitors faster than the 8th UK competitor will compete together, before UK competitors face off in seeded pairs. In other events, all 16 finalists will compete together, with the [top 8 UK competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b) being joined by the 8 remaining best competitors from any region. **Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind:** These events will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for these events, you must compete at the [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2026) or the [Kewbz UK Blindfolded Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKBLDChampionship2026). The podium winners of these competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2026. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4NDUxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6547f5d596befc73699700f8fea7d96dde8f8efb/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein Summer 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer, Thomas Strasser und Speedcubing Austria - sowie delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Langenstein Summer 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Norwegian Championship 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAyODYwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1e4894d78da01f540cf034021bf4d9bf981e69c8/nm2026.jpeg) ## 🇳🇴 (NB) Informasjon Velkommen til norgesmesterskapet i kubing 2026, denne gangen tilbake i Trondheim. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er hjertelig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇳🇴 (NN) Informasjon Velkomen til noregsmeisterskapen i kubing, som er tilbake i Trondheim i år. Konkurransen er open for alle som ynskjer å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegongsdeltakarar Førstegongsdeltakarar er hjarteleg velkomne til å delta på NM. Det blir ikkje stilt krav om kor rask ein må vere for å delta, og vi ynskjer å sjå flest mogeleg velje å delta. Vi oppmodar alle førstegongsdeltakarar til å lese [fana for førstegongsdeltakarar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2026, this time back in Trondheim. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

Upon arriving at Kids America, please check in at the Front Desk and follow the signs to your room. A Day Pass gives you access to: ⚽ Indoor Soccer 🏃 Indoor Track 🏀 Basketball 🏐 Volleyball 🥒 Pickleball 🏋️ Weight Room (under 18 requires a signed parent waiver, this can be taken care of at the front desk throughout the day) **Please view all signage regarding rules of the building.** Children 12 & under must have a parent/guardian on site at all times, admission is free for children 5 and under. Concessions will be open and available to all competitors and spectators. Due to potentially limited venue seating, competitors and spectators are highly encouraged to bring their own portable chairs.

items.name: Blenkir Junín 2026
items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Bienvenidos al tercer torneo del año 2026 en la ciudad de Huancayo. • Todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) • Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo. [Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY) • Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. • **ENGLISH** Welcome to the third competition of 2026 in Huancayo. • All competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) • We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted. [WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) • It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2026
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2026#76045-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2026#76045-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAwMzUyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--939fc012670dcd192564b199dee957c4d8084872/image.png) **This is a multi-site competition in Raymore, Missouri.** PBQ events (3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, MBLD, and FMC) will be held on August 7th at Centerview in Harrelson Hall B **(Address: 227 Municipal Cir, Raymore, MO)**. If you are not participating in these events, you are not required or obligated to attend this day, but you are welcome if you wish. All other events will be held on Saturday August 8th and Sunday August 9th at the Raymore Activity Center. The venues are both located in Raymore, about 2 miles apart. We have a local facebook group where we will be posting upcoming events as they are announced as well as supporting local cubing conversations for Missouri. Jump over and join the [Missouri Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1548283828980986) facebook group.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMzAyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--428789535e7c3039c185f53aeb1dafff592214a3/BCC%202026%20for%20Canva.ai%20(1800%20x%201800%20px)%20(1).png) ##CubingBC and Speedcubing Canada welcome you to BC Championship 2026! **Everybody is welcome to compete at the second-ever BC Championship!** Competitors from any country or region are invited to register, whether you’re a seasoned competitor or this is your very first competition. The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#66713-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information. For information regarding FMC, 4BLD, 5BLD, and MBLD, please refer to the [FMC/BLIND](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#67514-fmc-blind) tab. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition. All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations prior to competing. If this is your first competition, please refer to the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#62666-faq-resources) tab for helpful tips. --- To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) and follow CubingBC on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/p/Cubingbc-61569731858139/) or [Instagram.](https://www.instagram.com/cubingbc/) Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon. **Please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3ac052458bf99a2d6ce589b161550c7321f8e669/CubingBC%20and%20SpeedcubingCanadaLogo.png) **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety:** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/y4aZ08M.png) **Polski:** Zapraszamy na czwartą edycję Silesian Minx Fest - wyjątkowych zawodów z minxami na wolnym powietrzu! Wydarzenie jest organizowane dzięki wsparciu Wojewódzkiej Biblioteki Publicznej im. Emanuela Smołki w Opolu! Zapoznaj się ze wszystkimi zakładkami przed rejestracją. Zwróć szczególną uwagę, że konkurencje poniedziałkowe i wtorkowe, czyli 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia, 3x3x3 najmniejsza liczba ruchów oraz 4x4x4 bez patrzenia i 5x5x5 bez patrzenia odbędą się w innym obiekcie oddalonym od głównej sali (namiotu) o około 500m. Adres to ul. Krakowska 39, 45-075 Opole. --------- ![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png) **English:** We invite you to the fourth edition of Silesian Minx Fest - the unusual outdoor competition with minxes as the main theme! The competition is organized thanks to the support of the Voivodeship Public Library in Opole! Please check information in all tabs before registrating. Please note that Monday's and Tuesday's events: FMC, 4BLD, 5BLD and MBLD will take place in another venue about 500 m away from the main venue. The address: Krakowska 39, 45-075 Opole. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAzNTkzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9b9765836db845605e3f7adc48700700f9c0a0ca/logo%20wca%20poziom%20(1).png)

items.name: Elmsford Extravaganza II 2026
items.information: Please note that this competition takes place on a **Tuesday evening**. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU5MTUzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--46ab1631a987cfa9e97675e8167120b1a11f966b/Hawaii%20Championship%202026%20Final%20Transparent%20PNG.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png) ### Hawaii's first ever state championship is here! All competitors are welcome to attend and compete. Only Hawaiian residents will be eligible for the title of Hawaii State Champion. More information can be found on the [State Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HawaiiChampionship2026#67164-state-champion-eligibility) tab. --- ##### Different days will have different events. The following days will hold the following events: * Friday: 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 MultiBlind * Saturday: 3x3, 2x2, 4x4, 3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx, Skewb * Sunday: 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face Turning Octahedron **You are not required to be present on days you will not be competing.** --- * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial on Saturday at 9:00 AM.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgzNzQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--85d7f1c565dad12a0a3f3ad8a2e9946cf4745708/Anuncio_cuadrado.png) **¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026!** La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad. Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026**! **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** Durante el evento se realizarán fotografías y grabaciones de video que podrán ser utilizadas por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión institucional. Al participar, aceptas el uso de tu imagen conforme a lo establecido en nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ **Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026!** The Guelaguetza is much more than just a celebration — it is the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that defines this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community. And what better way to express this connection than through Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we are not only showcasing skill and dexterity, but also the ability to unite around a shared challenge, regardless of our background or culture. Don’t miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We’ll see you at **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026**! **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photographs and video recordings will take place during the event and may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotional, documentation, and outreach purposes. By attending, you consent to the use of your image in accordance with our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: **Important Information for Participants:** **Location:** The competition will take place at the conference hall. **Arrival Time:** Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering:** All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants:** If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement:** First-time participants are required to bring an original, printed, or digital copy of their official ID card. Please ensure you have this with you.. **Cube Requirement:** Participants must bring their own cubes. Participants are responsible for the safety of the puzzles. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants:** If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit a copy of your Government-issued ID. We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. **On The Spot Registration** * On The Spot (OTS) Registration has been enabled for this competition if 50 competitors do not complete online registration. * All OTS Registrants have to come on time and follow the schedule * OTS Registrations are only available on day 2 of the competition * OTS Registration is only available from 8:00 AM to 8:30 AM * OTS Registration is only available for 3x3, 2x2 and 3x3 OH

items.information: # Deuxième Compétition Officielle de Speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! L’aventure continue ! Après une première compétition en 2025, nous sommes ravis de vous accueillir pour la **deuxième compétition officielle WCA en Côte d’Ivoire**, qui aura lieu le **samedi 4 juillet** ! Que vous ayez déjà participé à une compétition ou que vous découvriez tout juste le speedcubing, cette compétition est faite pour vous. Plusieurs épreuves officielles seront au programme : **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 à une main**, **Skewb** et **Pyraminx**. Vous pouvez participer à celles que vous souhaitez ! **Première compétition WCA ?** Aucun problème ! Un **tutoriel pour les débutants** sera proposé pour vous expliquer le déroulement, les règles et l’arbitrage. Pensez simplement à apporter une **pièce d’identité** pour l’inscription. Rejoignez-nous pour continuer à faire grandir la communauté du speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire — venez résoudre, concourir et partager ce moment avec nous ! --- # Ivory Coast’s Second Official WCA Competition! The journey continues! After a first competition in 2025, we are excited to welcome you to the **second official WCA competition in Ivory Coast**, taking place on **Saturday, July 4th**! Whether you have already competed before or are just discovering speedcubing, this competition is for you. Several official events will be held: **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 One-Handed**, **Skewb**, and **Pyraminx**. Feel free to compete in any or all of them! **First WCA competition?** No worries! A **newcomer tutorial** will be available to guide you through the competition format, rules, and judging. Just remember to bring a valid **ID** for registration. Come and be part of the growing speedcubing community in Ivory Coast — solve, compete, and enjoy the experience together!

items.information: We are pleased to announce that the 2026 North American Championship will take place in Raleigh, North Carolina! items.information: North Carolina and Southeast Cubing, Inc. would like to welcome everyone to Raleigh for **[Rubik's WCA North American Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026)**! This Pride competition is to celebrate and support LGBTQ+ cubers and allies. Any person may register for this competition. **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpCarolinaPride2026#71720-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. $5 from every registration will be donated to **[The Trevor Project](https://www.thetrevorproject.org/)**. Their mission is to end suicide among LGBTQ+ young people and provide them support. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpCarolinaPride2026#71728-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY0MjIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4afae468e469b318f8b2a50ffa9d66355979028d/Copy_of_SOUTHEAST_but_as_a_prideflag_WITH_white_BG.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc3NjQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--347c0316155c3d0a9c0eebd9dc1ad1e753d13e12/PrideCube.png)

items.information: ## ABOUT THIS EVENT This competition will be the highest from ground level ever held in the World. This claim derives from our own research and is not an official measure from the WCA as the WCA does not track elevation or altitude as an official statistic. The competition will be held on the 45th floor of the hotel at 189m from ground level. It is also open for beginners to seasoned cubers alike. **Please note**: Due to capacity regulations, every competitor will only be allowed 1 (one) free spectator. We will have some additional spectator tickets to purchase at R100. Additional guests will be allowed on other floors of the Leonardo, however only those with spectator tickets will be allowed inside the cubing venue.

This event is a simultaneous FMC competition for fewest moves enthusiasts worldwide. In addition to the official global top three awards, the Guangzhou Site will present separate awards to its top three competitors. June 21, 2026 coincides with the summer solstice; at noon, the sun will directly shine on the Tropic of Cancer (23°26′N). After the morning fewest moves competition finishes, we cordially invite all competitors to gather at the nearby Guangzhou Tropic of Cancer Park. An award ceremony will be held in front of the Tropic of Cancer Memorial Tower, where competitors will jointly stack a tower column with Rubik's Cubes, witnessing the remarkable phenomenon of "an upright pole casting no shadow." Event page: https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMC2026 Registration process: First, complete registration via the event page above (WCA account login required). Then, pay the registration fee using Alipay to the Guangzhou Cubing account (gzcubeteam@gmail.com). Upon successful payment, registration will be confirmed. For any questions regarding registration or payment, please contact the organizer via email (same address as above), or search for the WeChat public account "动物魔友会Animal Cubing" and reach out to customer service within the public account. **About the Awards** 1) This competition only has the special-shaped puzzles speed-solving event. In addition to the awards for the top three in each event, awards will also be given to the first place in the competition in the sum of rankings of all events. If there is a tie in the total ranking, the better ranking of Pyraminx will be given priority based on most registration. 2) Competitors must accept any certificates, awards, or prizes in person. Competitors that do not appear in person will forfeit any prizes. 3) The main event of this event is the Pyraminx, and the first place in this event will be announced as the champion of this competition, with the best prizes. **Accompanying Persons and Spectators** To ensure a quiet and orderly competition environment, each competitor may bring a maximum of 1 accompanying person for free admission. Any additional accompanying persons must purchase an admission ticket on-site at the price of ¥50 per person per day. All accompanying persons must register together with the contestant. **Friendly Reminder** This competition does not have any official competitor chat groups. Please be mindful of protecting your personal information and property. If you have any questions, please email the organizers at gzcubeteam@gmail.com, or search for our official account "动物魔友会" (Animal Cubing) on WeChat and contact customer service through the account.

items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2026! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF for dere som gir oss beskjed om det. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members who inform us about their membership. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called. ​ * Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations. ​ * Kindly bring your ID card while entering the campus. ​ * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. ​ * Participants must bring their own cubes.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2026
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup. **Note for newcomers:** This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.information: Willkommen in der ehemaligen Hauptstadt – willkommen in Bonn! Zum allerersten Mal bringt ein Cubing-Turnier die Würfel-Community in diese traditionsreiche Stadt – und wir sind bereit, Geschichte zu schreiben. Freu dich auf ein Wochenende voller Spannung, persönlicher Bestzeiten, packender Finals und unvergesslicher Momente. Ob Newcomer oder Speedcubing-Profi – in Bonn wird gecubed, gefeiert und mitgefiebert! Sei dabei, wenn das erste Turnier in Bonn legendär wird. Melde dich jetzt an – wir können es kaum erwarten, dich dort zu sehen! Welcome to the former capital – welcome to Bonn! For the very first time, a cubing tournament is coming to this historic city – and we’re ready to make history together. Get ready for a weekend full of excitement, personal bests, thrilling finals, and unforgettable moments. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned speedcuber – in Bonn, we cube, we cheer, and we celebrate! Be part of Bonn’s very first tournament and help us make it legendary. Sign up now – we can’t wait to see you there! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYzNzI4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6111d603a3f42ad9b696e4a64eecc2b9664c2245/image.png)

items.name: Franconia Cube Days 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1ODE1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5b97380e04dc31adffc60a72bbfc202cab42c5f/FCD.jpg) ###Liebe Speedcuber/innen, Wir laden Euch herzlich zu den Franconia Cube Days 2026 ein. Diese Competition ist der direkte Nachfolger der "Frankfurt Cube Days", die von 2012 bis 2024 stattfanden. Nun sind wir nicht allzu weit umgezogen in die Nähe von Nürnberg, wo wir wieder eine tolle Venue gefunden haben. Wie in der Vergangenheit möchten wir sowohl Anfängern, als auch erfahrenen Cubern eine gute Erfahrung ermöglichen. Die Events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6 und OH werden im neuen Format "dual rounds" stattfinden, sofern das WCA Softwaresystem dies bis dahin unterstützt. Am Samstag Abend wird es wieder eine After-Comp geben, ganztägig Snacks und Getränke in der Venue und eine Cubing-Börse. Mehr dazu könnt ihr in den Tabs nachlesen. Wir feuen uns auf Euch. ###Dear competitors, Franconia Cube Days 2026 are open to every citizen from every nation. This competition is a direct successor of the "Frankfurt Cube Days" that originated in 2012. The new venue is near Nürnberg, which has good trafic connections by plane, train or car. Our goal is to create a great experience for beginners and advanced cubers aswell. You can stay at our "After-Comp" on saturday evening to have fun and to connect with other cubers. There will be snacks and beverages at the venue and also a cube-swap shop. Please have a look at the tabs for more information. We are looking forward to see you at the FCDs 2026.

items.information: ## West Coast Cubing welcomes you to Riverside for Western Championship 2026! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ2NjQzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cf643f8826077f011ac9001e0e28d1f7cb4b8b45/WesternsLogo%20-%20Edited.png) ### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66525-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Western Champs 2026!** The highest-placing competitor from the Western Region in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Western Champion! Check out the [Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66534-western-champion-eligibility) for more information. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the New Competitor section on the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66527-faq) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66533-sponsors).

items.information: This is the first Please Be Quiet competition held in the country, taking place at a radio station, marking a unique and innovative event where participants face a different kind of challenge one where control, focus, and silence are the keys to standing out. This competition is open to all public. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQSantaCruz922FM2026#74436-informacion-de-pago) **More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQSantaCruz922FM2026#74434-faq-pmf)** Esta es la primera competencia Please Be Quiet celebrada en el país, realizada en una emisora de radio, marcando un evento innovador y único que reúne a participantes en un desafío diferente, donde el control, la concentración y el silencio son la clave para destacar. Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico. Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQSantaCruz922FM2026#74436-informacion-de-pago) **Mas informacion acerca de las competencias ingresar a: [Preguntas frecuentes / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQSantaCruz922FM2026#74434-faq-pmf)** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc2OTA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d5ddd10397761fc27d6f316368905ca62e24b89f/bigs%20.jpg)

items.name: GLS Gdańsk IV 2026
items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: Hessen Open 2026
items.information: Hessen Open 2026 ist eine Zwei-Tages-Competition und Partner-Competition von Hessen Mini Open 2026, die am gleichen Wochenende, freitags, stattfinden wird. Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst. Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen. Hessen Open 2026 is open to every citizen from every nation. Hessen Open 2026 is a two-day competition and series competition to Hessen Mini Open 2026, which will be held at the same weekend, on friday. Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions. If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration.

items.name: Örebro Side Events 2026
items.information: Välkomna till den tredje upplagan av Örebro Side Events! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Denna tävling kommer också att inkludera inofficiella grenar, regler och resultat hittas på [**Cubing Contests**](https://cubingcontests.com). Läs mer under fliken Inofficiella Grenar. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to the third edition of Örebro Side Events! Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. This competition will also include Unofficial Events, rules and results can be found at **[Cubing Contests](https://cubingcontests.com)**. Read more under the tab Unofficial Events. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyNzIzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bf638126f96e668f65b37e3ce68edb80c6d49543/upen%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al UPEN Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de Nayarit!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 16 y domingo 17 de mayo de 2026. El UPEN Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Welcome to UPEN Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 16, and Sunday, May 17, 2026. UPEN Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** **Bem-vindos à segunda competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2026 promete a consolidação do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo consolidar a representatividade também em um Esporte da Mente! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** **Welcome to the second speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcwODMzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8353064ff996ef2d056815725f11f1ef2a0e7863/image.png) Το Halkida Spring Open 2026 θα είναι ο επόμενος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2026 και ο πρώτος που γίνεται ποτέ στην πανέμορφη πόλη της Χαλκίδας! Στη φιλόξενη και ευρύχωρη αίθουσα συνεδριάσεων του Lucy Hotel, παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο, θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Halkida Spring Open 2026 will be our next official competition of 2026 and the first ever to be held in the beautiful city of Halkida! In the welcoming conference hall of the Lucy Hotel, cubers from all over the country and beyond—young and old, new and experienced—will come together once again for our favorite hobby. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another cubing celebration! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU5MDQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4cb58b9882a96f08b772fdbe40b22da459dd42c3/amcm_lateral.png) ### 🇧🇷 Português Campeonato Mineiro 2026, em parceria com a Associação Mineira de Cultura Nipo-Brasileira! Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$50. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para a modalidade 3x3x3. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$50. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. Registrations on the spot will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer und Thomas Strasser und delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMjgzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ce5023c17fc9bf649fbe7e7c137c67c69bebbf8b/CaminosLeon.jpg) ##### *🎵"Bonito León, Guanajuato, la feria con su jugada, allí se apuesta la vida y se respeta al que gana..."🎶* ## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026 La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** comienza su recorrido en **León, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Este torneo forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo. En cada parada, la música de José Alfredo Jiménez acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a León. El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en León para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026 The "Caminos de Guanajuato" route begins in **León, Guanajuato**, a place that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and daily life intertwine in every corner. This tournament is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different locations under the same competitive and festive spirit. At each stop, the music of José Alfredo Jiménez symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have given voice to the Guanajuato spirit, inspire this edition dedicated to León. The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in León to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

The organizers of this competition will have to submit a list of all visitors (which includes the competitor and their adult chaperone if the competitor is a minor) to the NYU visitor system after registration has been finalized. If you would like to bring additional guests, please reach out to the organizers and we will let you know if there are any extra guest slots. ​ **NYU Students and Alumni:** NYU students and alumni will receive a full refund for their registration. items.name: Teknostallen 2026
items.information: ### 🇳🇴 Teknostallen 2026 Gjør deg klar for en fin kubehelg når vi inviterer til konkurranse i Teknostallen i Trondheim 28.–29. mars! Dette blir en helg med ekte konkurransestemning, offisielle tider og masse energi. Arrangementet er for ALLE – enten du løser kuben på 3 sekunder eller 3 minutter, og enten du er 7 eller 70 år. Her skal både nybegynnere og erfarne speedcubers samles for å dele lidenskapen for kuben og jakten på nye personlige rekorder. Konkurransen går over to dager inne i den spektakulære tropiske hagen i Teknostallen, en helt unik ramme for raske fingre og raske hoder. Det konkurreres i mange ulike grener, fra klassisk 3x3 til flere andre varianter. Dette blir en helg fylt med mestring, spenning og ekte kubeglede. Man går inn hovedinngangen på Teknostallen, og venteområdet kommer til å være under messaninen, mens konkurransene foregår oppe på messaninen. Det er gode muligheter for å kjøpe både mat og drikke fra de ulike plassene på bygget som Mellom, Glød og Snurr. --- ### 🇺🇸 Teknostallen 2026 Get ready for a great cube weekend as we invite you to a competition at Teknostallen in Trondheim on March 28–29. This will be a weekend filled with real competition atmosphere, official timing and plenty of energy. The event is for EVERYONE – whether you solve the cube in 3 seconds or 3 minutes, and whether you are 7 or 70 years old. Both beginners and experienced speedcubers will gather to share their passion for cubing and the pursuit of new personal bests. The competition takes place over two days inside the spectacular tropical garden at Teknostallen, a truly unique setting for fast fingers and fast minds. Multiple events will be held, from the classic 3x3 to several other variations. Expect a weekend filled with achievement, excitement and true cube joy. Enter through the main entrance of Teknostallen. The waiting area will be located under the mezzanine, while the competitions take place on the mezzanine level. There will be great opportunities to purchase food and drinks from the various venues in the building, including Mellom, Glød and Snurr.

items.information: * We will be giving out free Penn Cube Day tote bags for competitors. * Current UPenn students are entitled to free registration. Please leave your Penn email in the registration comment and pay the fee. We will refund if you are qualified. * We will have newcomer (competitors attending their first competition) podium for 3×3, based on the result of 3×3 round 1. * We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. Missing your group risks potential disqualification from the event. * Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants. * Food and drinks are NOT permitted inside the main room. You may eat elsewhere in Houston Hall. There are a few restaurants within a ten minute walk/drive. * Live results will be posted on WCA Live.

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** Sejam todos bem-vindos à mais uma competição Capivara em parceria com o Colégio SEB Dom Bosco! Esta é uma edição muito especial, em homenagem ao Mês da Mulher. Para celebrar essa data tão importante, teremos pódios femininos em todas as modalidades, incluindo a categoria iniciante. Chamem suas amigas e venham comemorar conosco esse momento de reconhecimento e valorização! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=OQ1vLrsJVqagiDna). This is a very special edition, held in honor of Women’s Month. To celebrate this important occasion, we will have female podiums in all event categories, including the beginner category. Invite your friends and come celebrate this meaningful and empowering moment with us! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=Sq18haJ3WPk2AG82). It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information: Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында ұйымдастырылады. Жарыстан жиналған барлық қаражат туа біткен екіжақты құлақ атрезиясы мен микротия диагнозы қойылған Данелияның еміне бағытталады. Данелия дерлік естімейді, сөйлеуі қиын, бұл оның жалпы дамуына әсер етуде. Қазіргі таңда ол сүйек өткізгіштігі бар есту аппаратын қолданады, алайда ол жиі бұзылып, баланың белсенді өміріне төтеп бере алмайды. Биыл Данелия 5 жасқа толады, және медициналық көрсеткіштер бойынша оған бас сүйегіне имплантация немесе каналопластика операциясы қажет. АҚШ дәрігері ұсынған каналопластика операциясы Данелияның есту қабілетін қалпына келтіріп, есту жолын кеңейтуге және өмір бойы есту аппаратына тәуелді болмауға мүмкіндік беруі мүмкін. Жиналған қаражат тікелей қолма-қол берілмейді. Барлық жарналар ресми түрде «ZHALAIRI» қайырымдылық қоры арқылы қабылданып, Данелияның еміне заңды және ашық түрде бағытталады. Жарыс Алтын сауда орталығында ,3 қабаттары холлда өтеді. Сіздің қолдауыңыз Данелияға толыққанды өмір сүруге үлкен үміт сыйлайды. Баршаңызды қайырымдылық жарысына қатысуға және қолдау көрсетуге шақырамыз English: The competition is organized for charitable purposes. All funds raised during the event will be directed toward the treatment of Danelia, who has been diagnosed with congenital bilateral ear atresia and microtia. Danelia can barely hear and has difficulty speaking, which affects her overall development. Currently, she uses a bone-conduction hearing device; however, it frequently breaks down and cannot withstand an active child’s lifestyle. This year, Danelia turns 5 years old, and according to medical indications, she requires either a skull implantation procedure or canaloplasty surgery. The canaloplasty surgery recommended by a U.S. doctor may help restore Danelia’s hearing, widen the ear canal, and allow her to live without lifelong dependence on a hearing device. The collected funds will not be handed directly in cash. All donations will be officially received through the «ZHALAIRI» charitable foundation and will be legally and transparently allocated to Danelia’s treatment. The competition will take place at Altyn Shopping Center, 3rd floor hall. Your support gives Danelia great hope for a full and happy life. We invite everyone to participate in the charity competition and show their support.

items.information: **🇧🇷 Português:** A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- **🇺🇸 English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). ❗️**IMPORTANTE** Nesta competição estaremos com uma campanha beneficente que visa a ajuda para os mais necessitados. Também teremos premiação para as 3 pessoas que mais doarem durante os dias de campeonato! Assim, além de nos divertimos, contribuímos para a construção de um mundo melhor. Saiba mais na pagina [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) 💵 **PREMIAÇÃO EM DINHEIRO** 💵 Nesta competição, estaremos realizando a premiação em dinheiro para o pódio da modalidade principal do campeonato, o Clock. Todas as informações estão dispostas na página [Premiação em Dinheiro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da primeira modalidade em que vai competir. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', e "Feminino" que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. 🇬🇧 **English:** Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. We'll also have prizes for the three people who donate the most during the competition! This way, we'll not only have fun, but we'll also contribute to building a better world. Learn more on the [Charity Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) page. 💵 **CASH PRIZES** 💵 In this competition, we will be awarding cash prizes for the podium finishers in the main event, Clock. All information is available on the [Cash Prizes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) page.
